verdict.rationale: Brave's API family covers all three steps under one API key. Web Search handles retrieval, the LLM Context endpoint returns pre-extracted, token-budgeted page content "no scraping", and Answers or the Summarizer produce synthesized output grounded on "a single search or multiple searches". The official MCP server also bundles web search, LLM context and summarization so an agent can chain them. Missing for 10: on-demand content extraction from arbitrary URLs (extraction is limited to pages surfaced by search), a documented end-to-end multi-step research endpoint or workflow example, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the chained flow.
